# telnyx_10dlc_brand_sms_otp_verify (Action)

Verifies the SMS one-time password a sole proprietor 10DLC brand received, which completes the brand's identity verification.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `brand_id` (String) The brand id.
- `otp_pin` (String) The OTP PIN received via SMS
